meta.name: update-nanoclaw
meta.description: Efficiently bring upstream NanoClaw updates into a customized install, with preview, selective cherry-pick, and low token usage.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 预览上游更新,挑选合入定制安装
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果维护着定制版NanoClaw,想便捷同步官方更新
copy.tagline_en: Preview upstream updates and cherry-pick them into your customized install
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you maintain a customized NanoClaw and want to sync official updates

howto.what: 该技能指导你合并NanoClaw最新更新:先备份,再预览改动,让你选合并方式;冲突时只解冲突标记,最后构建、测试并查破坏性变更。
howto.when: 当你在 Claude Code 中运行 /update-nanoclaw 命令时触发,用于把上游NanoClaw更新合入你自定义的安装。

say.text: 运行 /update-nanoclaw,把上游更新合进来
say.note: Claude会先备份并预览,再让你选合并方式。

say.text: 这次用 cherry-pick,只选我指定的提交
say.note: 会跳过其他改动,只应用你挑选的提交。

say.text: 只要预览,先别改任何东西
say.note: 会显示上游改动和分类,但不做合并。

howto.what_en: This skill guides you through safely merging the latest NanoClaw updates: it backs up first, previews changes, lets you choose a merge method, resolves only conflict markers, then builds, tests, and checks for breaking changes.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you run /update-nanoclaw in Claude Code, to bring upstream NanoClaw updates into your customized install.

say_en.note: Claude backs up, previews, then asks how to merge.

say_en.text: Use cherry-pick and only apply the commits I choose
say_en.note: Other upstream changes are skipped; only your picks applied.

say_en.text: Just preview, don't change anything yet
say_en.note: Shows upstream changes and categories, no merge.
